{"templateId": "eeaa9b5d-78e4-55ba-98d9-0f6ae221111e", "title": "Follow up on account security concern", "text": "Security concern type: unauthorized access
Affected account or platform: Velvet Acorn Custody
Date client reported concern: 2025-11-06
Client's preferred contact method: phone
Immediate action requested: notify custodian / reset credentials / monitor activity
Custodian or platform contact: Velvet Acorn Custody
Evidence to review: Paige Lanternmoss's forwarded login alert for a session she did not recognize and her statement that she could not verify whether recent account activity was legitimate
Resolution status: open
Next client update: phone update to Paige Lanternmoss by 2025-11-07
Internal notes: Coordinate custodian escalation, evidence documentation, and credential reset coordination for the unrecognized Velvet Acorn Custody login alert.", "priority": "high", "dueDate": "2025-11-07", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-07 covering custodian escalation, evidence documentation, credential reset coordination, and a phone update to Paige."},
{"templateId": "d59658c9-3bcc-573c-a34e-479818bc4c60", "title": "Follow up on missing signature", "text": "Contact the signer through the approved communication channel to explain which document still needs signature, where to sign, and how to return it securely. Confirm receipt of the completed signature page and update the document status log. Contact Darin Lanternmoss for the household authorization package: the portal upload contains Paige Lanternmoss's signed pages but not Darin's signature page.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2025-11-10", "assigneeId": "ddfe45a4-1a81-5a26-8db5-0d7287fbbec9", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-10 to contact Darin through the approved channel, explain the required signature location, and confirm secure return of the signed page."},
{"templateId": "340a01fd-6530-54e3-8336-c6224508592f", "title": "Track custodian transfer status", "text": "Check the pending transfer with the receiving custodian, note the latest status, and alert the advisor if assets, cost basis, or residual cash have not arrived as expected. For the taxable account move, the Velvet Acorn Custody transfer tracker shows securities received from Teacup Comet Brokerage, but the cost basis file and a small residual cash sweep do not match the sending statement Paige Lanternmoss uploaded; document whether remaining assets or basis details are still pending.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2025-11-12", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-12 to check the receiving custodian’s latest status and document whether remaining assets or basis details are still pending."},
{"templateId": "96edd7b2-1df4-595b-96aa-9e7c04b9813d", "title": "Complete beneficiary update workflow", "text": "Use this workflow when a client needs to add, remove, or revise beneficiary designations. Confirm the requested change, gather the required custodian forms or online instructions, submit the update, and verify the custodian's final confirmation before closing the loop with the client. Paige Lanternmoss requested changes to the IRA beneficiary records at Velvet Acorn Custody, including revised primary and contingent percentages for Darin Lanternmoss, Liora Lanternmoss, and the Willow Pudding Family Trust; flag any trust wording that may require estate attorney review.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2025-11-14", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [
{"title": "Confirm beneficiary instructions", "text": "Review the client's requested beneficiary changes, including primary and contingent beneficiaries, percentages, relationship details, and any per stirpes or trust-related language. Flag anything that requires attorney or estate planning review. Confirm Paige Lanternmoss's revised primary and contingent percentages for Darin, Liora, and the Willow Pudding Family Trust.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "08744d31-7555-51ee-a1eb-a482b9defeeb", "dueDate": null},
{"title": "Prepare custodian documentation", "text": "Identify the correct beneficiary update method for each affected account, prepare forms or portal steps, and confirm whether spousal consent, medallion signature guarantee, or trust documentation is required. Identify the correct Velvet Acorn Custody process for the IRA beneficiary update.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "ddfe45a4-1a81-5a26-8db5-0d7287fbbec9", "dueDate": null},
{"title": "Submit and track update", "text": "Submit the completed documentation through the approved custodian channel and track the request until the custodian confirms the beneficiary record has been updated.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "ddfe45a4-1a81-5a26-8db5-0d7287fbbec9", "dueDate": null},
{"title": "Confirm completion with client", "text": "Send the client a concise confirmation that the beneficiary update has been completed, noting any accounts still pending or any items the client should retain with estate documents.", "priority": "low", "assigneeId": "08744d31-7555-51ee-a1eb-a482b9defeeb", "dueDate": null}
], "evidence": "They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-14 to confirm the requested designations, identify the correct custodian process, and flag any trust wording that may require estate attorney review."},
{"templateId": "ff5229e6-e93f-5a25-852e-f97d59d919cf", "title": "Review insurance policy details", "text": "Complete the following checks:
- Confirm policy type, owner, insured, beneficiary, and premium payer.
- Review current death benefit, cash value, surrender value, riders, and premium schedule if applicable.
- Check whether beneficiary designations align with the client's estate and family goals.
- Identify pending premium increases, lapse risk, term expiration, conversion options, or long-term care benefit triggers.
- Request the most recent in-force illustration or policy statement when needed.
- Note any tax, estate, liquidity, or coverage gaps to discuss with the advisor.
- Document whether outside insurance, legal, or tax professionals should be consulted.
Obtain current policy evidence for Paige Lanternmoss's $1 million Silver Marmot Life term policy (runs through 2028) and Darin Lanternmoss's $750,000 Silver Marmot Life term policy (runs through 2030); the client file has declarations pages only and lacks the current premium schedule, conversion language, and recent policy statements needed to assess coverage timing, premium changes, and beneficiary alignment.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": null, "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Current policy evidence is needed before Apricot Compass can assess coverage timing, premium changes, and beneficiary alignment; no due date was supplied."},
{"templateId": "b91c5012-f119-507f-91de-d78d8599cb42", "title": "Review charitable transfer readiness", "text": "Review the proposed charitable transfer using these criteria and collect supporting evidence:
- Confirm intended recipient is a qualified charity or eligible donor-advised fund sponsor.
- Confirm asset type, estimated value, cost basis if available, holding period, and whether appreciated securities are involved.
- Confirm source account registration and authority to give transfer instructions.
- Verify delivery instructions, including recipient name, tax identification details if provided securely, custodian delivery method, and any special purpose or designation language.
- Check whether the gift should be coordinated with the client's tax advisor for deductibility, AGI limits, bunching strategy, or required minimum distribution treatment.
- Confirm whether the client needs an acknowledgment letter, gift receipt, or confirmation for tax records.
- Evidence to collect: client authorization, current position or cash balance, charity delivery instructions, custodian form or portal confirmation, and final transfer confirmation.
Paige Lanternmoss is considering a gift of appreciated Copper Firefly Systems shares (about $390,000 position with an estimated $95,000 cost basis in the Velvet Acorn Custody joint taxable account) to Marzipan Meadow Arts Fund during her year-end giving window; the 2024 return showed $18,000 of charitable gifts.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2025-11-21", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-21 covering the proposed asset, charity delivery instructions, tax coordination questions, and confirmation evidence needed for Paige’s records."},
{"templateId": "50d179d5-bb11-5ca0-8930-540d0d108c9b", "title": "Prepare retirement income plan", "text": "Prepare an updated retirement income scenario for Paige Lanternmoss using the Copper Firefly Systems voluntary separation offer terms, which could move her full-time retirement earlier than the prior 2029 assumption. Incorporate household spending of about $15,800 per month, cash reserves of about $142,000 at Teacup Comet Bank, Darin Lanternmoss's variable freelance income through Paper Otter Design Studio (averaging about $96,000 annually), and estimated Social Security benefits of $3,420 per month for Paige and $2,310 per month for Darin.", "priority": null, "dueDate": null, "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "An updated retirement income scenario is needed using the offer terms, household spending, cash reserves, and Darin’s variable income assumptions; no due date was supplied."}
]}
